Real use cases

Sourced research questions Get an answer with citations you can verify yourself.
Current-events questions Answers that reflect recent information, not a training cutoff.
Fast fact-checking Quickly confirm a claim with linked sources.

Bottom line

Perplexity's whole design points at one job: answering questions you can verify. Every answer comes with sources attached, which makes it the tool we reach for first on factual or current-events questions. It's less suited to open-ended creative writing, where a general assistant will serve you better.

Frequently asked questions

Is Perplexity free?

Yes, with a free tier; deeper research modes are more limited without a subscription.

Does Perplexity cite its sources?

Yes — this is its core feature, with links attached to most claims.

Is Perplexity good for creative writing?

Not really its strength — it's built for sourced, factual answers rather than open-ended creative work.

Does Perplexity have an API?

Yes, API access is available.

How current are Perplexity's answers?

It searches the live web, so answers reflect recent information rather than only a training cutoff.

When was Perplexity last tested by Luvent?

We last tested it on 2026-07-18.
